title: 第518章 村花第517章 有面子
content_zh:
第518章村花
陈楚刚到桃树村的工地不久，前面便围拢了一群人。
那是咋回事？
陈楚问一个工人。
工人赶过去查看，随后跑回来汇报工作：
“老板，不好了，还是那个赵小抠，他躺在那不让修路，还在讹钱。”
陈楚道：
“你找几个人给他抬走不行啊？”
工人一脸为难：
“他现在有条腿，还有点瘸，说谁敢碰他，他就讹谁，我们都是上有老下有小，来这赚点钱不容易，不敢碰啊。”
“我明白了。”
陈楚想了想，精神力量散发出去。
此时的赵小抠躺在路中间，嘴里还咧着笑，小声嘀咕：
“这个该死的陈楚，只要他敢过来，老子就讹死他，没10万块钱不起来。”
陈楚明白了，这家伙就是设圈套，想让自己往里面钻呢。
而在路两边的苞米地，他的两个傻儿子赵大柱和赵二柱也在那等着，只要自己一过去把他爹扯起来，两个傻儿子就冲上来开始讹钱。
这家伙是父子三人一个团伙。
好在他女儿赵倩倩明事理，又漂亮又懂事，小嘴还贼甜，跟赵倩倩亲个嘴，现在还能感觉到那种甜蜜呢。
陈楚忽然想到了赵三，可以以疑制疑，废物利用，便给赵三打去电话：
“赵三啊，交给你个活。”

“啥事啊楚哥，有事你吩咐。”
此时的赵三刚吃完早饭，吃的李宝面子正足，风头正劲。
“赵三啊，这件事非你不可，你不是村子里面说了算吗？赵小抠在我的工地前面挡着路不让我施工，你去给他扯起来。”
“哦，就是那个赵大宝，臭无赖啊。楚哥，这件事交给我了，保证完成任务。”
赵三说完骑着摩托车赶到了现场，就看见赵小抠躺在那里。
“这讹人，今天不管你们谁来，都得给我10万块钱，不给我10万块钱我就不起来。陈楚呢，让他滚过来。”
“哼，陈楚没到，老子到了。”
赵三儿片腿从摩托车上下来，对着赵小抠就是一脚。
“哎呦呦，你敢踢我，老子讹死你。”
赵小抠起身去看，一见是赵三，脸色就变了。
一物降一物，赵小抠虽然无赖，但是不敢惹赵三。
这家伙9岁的时候都能骑火签子，把自己整成个废人，这小子得多生性啊，人家一个废人早就置生死于度外了。
赵小抠抿了抿嘴：
“赵三，这件事跟你有啥关系，你回家去吧，我不想讹你。”
“哼哼，我楚哥的事就是我的事。赵小抠，你想讹我楚哥，先问问我老东西，我就问你起不起来，不起来我，你就可以永远不起来了。”
赵三四下查看一下，走到壕沟里捡起半块砖头：
“老东西，我他妈一砖头拍死你。”
赵小抠吓的急忙爬起来，一瘸一拐的往先跑。
“老东西，你别跑啊，你给我站住。”
赵小抠一边跑一边担心赵三真给他一下子，扯着嗓子喊：

“杀人啦，救命啊！赵三，咱俩一笔写不出个赵字，你咋能帮着外人呢？”
“放屁，老子这是帮理不帮亲，为民除害。”
赵小扣一路一瘸一拐的跑回家，但是并不甘心。
content_en:
Chapter 518 Village Beauty
Not long after Chen Chu arrived at the construction site in Taoshu Village, a group of people gathered in front of him.
What's going on?
Chen Chu asked a worker.
The worker rushed over to check, and then ran back to report the work:
"Boss, it's bad, it's still the same Zhao Xiaozhao. He's lying there refusing to let the road be built, and he's still extorting money."
Chen Chu said:
"Can't you find a few people to carry him away?"
The worker looked embarrassed:
"He has one leg now and is a little lame. He will blackmail anyone who dares to touch him. We are all old and young. It is not easy to make some money here, so we don't dare to touch him."
"I understand."
Chen Chu thought for a while, and then his spiritual power spread out.
At this time, Zhao Xiaozhao was lying in the middle of the road, still grinning and muttering in a low voice:
"This damn Chen Chu, as long as he dares to come here, I will blackmail him to death. I can't get up without 100,000 yuan."
Chen Chu understood that this guy just set a trap and wanted to get himself into it.
And at Baomi Di on both sides of the road, his two silly sons, Zhao Dazhu and Zhao Erzhu, were also waiting there. As soon as he went over to pick up his father, the two silly sons rushed up and started to extort money.
This guy is a gang of three father and son.
Fortunately, his daughter Zhao Qianqian is sensible, beautiful and sensible, and has a very sweet mouth. She can still feel the sweetness after kissing Zhao Qianqian.
Chen Chu suddenly thought of Zhao San, who could use suspicion to avoid suspicion, so he called Zhao San:
"Zhao San, I'll give you a job."
"What's the matter, Brother Chu? You can give me orders if you have anything to do."
At this time, Zhao Sang had just finished breakfast, and Li Bao was in a good mood.
"Zhao San, this matter must be done by you. Aren't you the one who has the final say in the village? Zhao Xiaozhao is blocking the road in front of my construction site and preventing me from doing construction. Go and help him."
"Oh, it's that Zhao Dabao, a stinking scoundrel. Brother Chu, leave this matter to me. I promise to complete the task."
After Zhao San finished speaking, he rushed to the scene on his motorcycle and saw Zhao Xiaojie lying there.
"This blackmailer, no matter who of you comes today, you have to give me 100,000 yuan. If you don't give me 100,000 yuan, I won't get up. Where is Chen Chu, tell him to get out of here."
"Humph, Chen Chu didn't arrive, but I did."
Zhao San'er got off the motorcycle with one leg and kicked Zhao Xiao.
"Ouch, if you dare to kick me, I will blackmail you to death."
Zhao Xiaozhao stood up and took a look. When he saw it was Zhao San, his expression changed.
One thing brings another down. Although Zhao Xiaozhao is a rogue, he does not dare to offend Zhao San.
When this guy was 9 years old, he could ride a fire stick and turn himself into a useless person. How talented this kid is. A useless person would have put his life and death at risk long ago.
Zhao Xiaotou pursed his lips:
"Zhao San, what does this matter have to do with you? You can go home. I don't want to blackmail you."
"Humph, Brother Chu's business is my business. Zhao Xiaozhao, if you want to blackmail me, Brother Chu, ask me first, and then I'll ask you if you can get up. If you don't get up with me, you can never get up."
Zhao San looked around, walked to the trench and picked up half a brick:
"Old man, I'll beat you to death with a fucking brick."
Zhao Xiaojie was so frightened that he hurriedly got up and limped forward.
"Old guy, don't run away, stop right there."
As Zhao Xiaozhao ran, he was worried that Zhao Sanzhen would give him a break, and shouted at the top of his lungs:
"It's murder, help! Zhao San, we can't write the character Zhao in one stroke, how can you help outsiders?"
"Fart, I'm just helping the manager, not the relatives, to get rid of harm for the people."
Zhao Xiaokou limped all the way home, but he was not resigned to it.
